translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Aaen Jesus Menaw Sefaaen
Sunday nee oatosor moawugowug nge rhooapwut kkewe ra mwet noa reen paeyi we, nge re pweipwog noa neoningas kkewe re oamoannatae.
Ra noa weri fai we pwe a mwagiut saengi aesemaen paeyi we,
iwe ra toonong noan paeyi we; nge rese rhuungi miniwe oanongaen Soamwoon Jesus.
Ra riu reen meeta we a wen, iwe rhag nge riiurhai mwaaen igin marettin mengaagiiur ra iu me oaroor.
Reen aar igin mesag, rhooapwut kkewe ra foatotiw nee ppweon, nge mwaaen kkewe ra aengaeniir pwe, “Meeta faan aaemi giutta mwaaen e menaw me neeiir rhooa mae reen?
Esa nono igeei; a menaw sefaaen tae. Oaw maengiy meeta we e aengaenigaemi igiwe eno noan Galilee:
‘Mwaaen we Naiun Aeremas ina epwene toonong nee paiiur rhooa monofit, repwe kurusuw noa, nge mwirin enuuw raaen epwe menaw sefaaen tae.’ ”
Iwe nge ra maengiy noa meeta kkewe Jesus e aepesa,
ra sefaaen saengi paeyi we, ra noa fioangei ngaeniir rhooawe seig me erhai rhooan kkayeo me pwan oanongeer rhooawe aaemweoi.
Rhooapwut kkewe iwe Maria Magdalene, Joanna, me Maria we inaen James; iir me rhooapwut kkewe aaemweoi ra aengaeniir oapostonus kkewe minikkewe a wen.
Nge oapostonus kkewe ra maengiy pwe meeta we rhooapwut kkewe re aepesa nge min ffeeoretae rhag, iwe rese niugiuniug ngaeniir.
Nge Peter a iutae rhag nge a fattapw noa reen paeyi we; a pwoarotiw nge a weri pwe a mengaag kkewe rhag. Iwe a mwet sefaaen noa nee iimw nge a mwaar reen meeta we a wen.
Faaeraeg Ngaeni Emmaus
Noan raaenin we rhag nge riiurhai mwaaen kkewe rhoaniuwaen Jesus ra faaeraeg ngaeni eew soapw itan Emmaus, iwe epwe fisuuw miles saengi Jerusalem,
iwe nge regaen mwaenieniy fengaen wooar reen oanongaen meeta kkewe a wen.
Igiwe re kekkepas me fioangei minikkewe, nge Jesus a noa arapeto reer iwe a itto faaeraeg eew noa meyiir;
nge ra weri nge rese giuneei pwe Jesus miniwe.
Jesus a aengaeniir pwe, “Meeta mwu oaw iyaepesa fengaenniy, wooan aaemi feffaaeraeg noa?” Iwe ra iunoa, ra mas affayeo noa.
Erhai me neeiir, itan Cleopas, a aeiineow pwe, “Een rhag me neeiir waseona wooan Jerusalem minne wose giuneei meeta kka a wewwen noan raaenin kkewe a noa?”

“Meeta kena?” a aeiyeg. Ra paniuwaeni pwe, “Minikkewe ewen ngaeni Jesus re Nazareth we. Mwaaeneei nge erhai profeta, iwe Deus me oanongeer aeremas nge re giuneei pwe eyor maemaewan noan oanongaen meeta kka e iura me feeori.
Soamwoonin patere me mwaaen kkewe aarh ra fangenoa pwe repwe noa niiy noa, iwe me kurusuw noa.
Nge aeiya iseni aemaem aepiniugiuniug wooan pwe iiy minne epwene saeneti noa Israel me noan aenneew! Nge soapw ina rhag, pwe a enuuw raaen mwirin aan wen minikkewe.
Aaemweoi rhooapwut kkewe rhoaniuwarh minne re ariugemaem; renoa reen paeyi we nee oatosor moawugowug,
nge rese weri miniwe oanongan. Ra sefaaeneto nge ra iura pwe aaemweoi angkenus repwae ngaeniir nge ra aengaeniir pwe iiy a menaw sefaaen tae.
Aaemweoi aemaem ra noa reen paeyi we nge ra noa weri pwe oanongaen meeta kkewe rhooapwut kkewe re aepesa nge ennet, pwe rese weri minna oanongan.”
Iwe Jesus a aengaeniir pwe, “A ifa mwo pwurhomi, me mmwaeyin aaemi niugiuniug ngaeni oanongaen meeta profeta kkewe re iura!
Pwe esoapw faer ieei wusun aaen Kristus waeiraes reen minikkeei weni mmwaen aan noa toonong noan minna nningen?”
Iwe Jesus a aemmetefa ngaeniir meeta kkewe kkepesan me noan oanongaen Pwapwior we e Santus, rhaepetae me noan mini pwapwioron Moses me oanongaen minikkewe foatogieer profeta kkewe.
Igiwe ra arapeto reen soapw we re faaeraeg ngaeni, Jesus a feeori pwetae epwe faaeraeg saengiir;
nge iir ra ammwarhiu sefaaeniy, ra iura pwe, “Notiw remaem, epwene oaropaen pwoong nge iye a rorhappiung noa.” Iwe a toonong pwe epwene notiw reer.
Iwe a mooat tiw pwe epwene mwongo reer, a pwigi fenoawa we, nge a maeipina; a giniiy fenoawa we nge a ngaenneer.
Iwe egius mwo nge eppwun noa meseer nge ra giuneei pwe iiy, iwe rhag nge e soano saengiir.

Ra iura fengaenniy pwe, “Meeta ese weei rhag ppwunon aengaet me noan tiparh, igiwe e mwaenieniy ngaenigirh me wooan ennap reen aan aemmetefa ngaenigirh meeta we e foatofoat noan Pwapwior we e Santus?”
Ra iutae rhag ra noa Jerusalem, ra noa rhuungi rhooan kkayeo kkewe seig me erhai me rhooawe aaemweoi,
ra iura pwe, “A menaw sefaaen Soamwoon! A pwae ngaeni Simon!”
Rhooawe riiurhai ra itto fioangei ngaeniir miniwe ewen me wooan ennap, me wunuunun aar giuneei pwe iiy Soamwoon igiwe a giniiy fenoawa we.
Jesus a Pwae Ngaeniir Rhooan Kkayeo Kkewe Naiun
Oatowe rhooa kkewe riiurhai re rhiuwen mwaenieniy, nge Soamwoon e rhiuwen iunoa rhag me neeiir nge a aengaeniir pwe, “Oapoas epwe no reemi.”
Ra igin mesag pwe ra maengiy pwe ra weri erhai aniu.
Nge a aengaeniir pwe, “Meeta oawwa aiuraeg reen? Meeta oawtip mwaramwar fetaen reen?
Oaw pipiiy paeyi me pirheei, pwe oawpwe weri pwe ngaang minneen. Oaw geotteopayaei, pwe oawpwe giuneei, pwe esooar aniu ne egaen yor fitigon me rhiun, nge oawpwe weri pwe eyor wooai.”
Igiwe e aepesa minneei nge a pwaeri ngaeniir paiun me pirheen.
Nge iir resaaen niugiuniug rhag, reen aar igin kker me tip mwaramwar; iwe a aeiineeor pwe, “Eyor minne sipwe mwongo me igeei?”
Iwe ra ngaenneei egiufet iig appwerh,
iwe e pwigi nge a aengi me weni mmweer aeremas kkewe.

Iwe a aengaeniir pwe, “Ikkeei minikkewe i fasiun aengaenigaemi oatowe i rhiuwen no reemi: oanongaen minikkewe effoat pwe wunuunuy noan Oasoapwosoapw we aaen Moses, me minikkewe foatogieer profeta kkewe, iwe me noan pwapwioron Psalms nge epwe nnet.”
Nge a sugi noa aar niunniuwaen pwe repwe metefaaegini oawton Pwapwior we e Santus,
nge a aengaeniir pwe, “Ieen miniwe effoat: Kristus epwe affayeo nge a menaw sefaaen mwirin eoniuraen,
nge noan minna itan nge kkepas we kkepesaen toagun saengi monofit iwe me sessaenin monofit epwe fenaiuw ngaeniir oanongaen faniuw, epwe rhaepetae me Jerusalem.
Aaemi rhooan pwaeritae oanongaen minikkeei.
Iwe nge ngaang ipwene aefengatiw woami meeta we mwaaen we Semaei e ppwoneei. Nge aaemi oawpwe no rhag nee aepinoamw toori aan ittiw woami maemaew na wooai naaeng.”
Jesus a Noa Naaeng
A pwigiir wow me noan aepinoamw we toori noa Bethany, igiwe a aeititae paiun nge a aepiniir noa.
Nugunupaen aan aepiniir nge a nigitiir pwe a noa weei naaeng.
Iir ra oassoara iiy nge ra sefaaen noa Jerusalem, reen aar igin kker,
nge ra no rhag noan Temple we reen aar fang ngaeni Deus aan aerhigerhig.
